name: Insight Acquisition Corp. Units
summary: Insight Acquisition Corp. Units consist of one share of Class A common stock and one-third of one redeemable warrant. Insight Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company focuses on targets within the financial technology, data and analytics, and software industries.
